reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "float": a gentle float that keeps a held frame alive without demanding attention.
Grounds light → accent → light → ink: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Its shape was 0.71 similar to sit-personal-finance-companion-search-1--instagram-reel; a different film, not the same one re-coloured.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Pinterest video pin (0.32s a word), inside 12–35s.
